Definition: Zerachjah, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Zerahiah = "Jehovah has risen"; 1) a priest, son of Uzzi, and ancestor of Ezra the scribe; 2) father of Elihoenai of the sons of Pahath-moab, whose descendants returned from the captivity with Ezra
